_doc.purpose: Static joker table. Every entry carries a plain-English `description` because beginner mode (spec 5a) must be able to say what a joker does without the player remembering. Entries additionally carry a declarative `effects` list where the joker's scoring contribution can be modelled exactly.
_doc.honesty_rule: A joker with `unmodelled: true`, or one whose effect needs a `counter` the adapter did not supply, does not silently score as zero. It makes the whole candidate play `exact: false` and lands in `unmodelled`, and the advisor is told it may not quote that number. Guessing a joker value is the exact failure the architecture exists to prevent (spec section 1).
_doc.counter_convention: `internal_state.counter` is the number the game itself displays on the joker right now. For an Xmult scaling joker (Obelisk, Hologram, Vampire, ...) that displayed number IS the current Xmult, so the effect reads `{"from": "counter"}` with no scaling constant. This deliberately keeps per-joker growth rates out of this file: a growth constant transcribed wrong is an invented number, and the adapter can always read the true current value from the game.

effect_grammar.if: predicate. For on_scored/on_held: suit, rank, rank_class (face|number|even|odd|ace), enhancement, seal, first_only. For independent: hand_contains, max_played, discards_remaining, hands_remaining, all_held_suit.
effect_grammar.chips|mult|xmult: a number, or {from: <source>, scale: s, base: b} meaning base + scale * source
effect_grammar.sources: counter, deck_remaining, money, hands_remaining, discards_remaining, joker_count, empty_joker_slots_incl_self, hand_played_count, steel_in_deck, enhanced_in_deck
effect_grammar.times: for retrigger_* only: how many extra times the matching card fires

_doc.flags: Some jokers change hand DETECTION rather than scoring (four_fingers, shortcut, smeared, pareidolia, splash). Those carry a `flag` instead of `effects`.

jokers.name: Half Joker

jokers.name: Joker Stencil
jokers.description: Multiplies your Mult by 1 for each empty Joker slot you have. Joker Stencil's own slot counts as empty.

jokers.name: Four Fingers
jokers.description: Flushes and Straights can be made with only 4 cards instead of 5.

jokers.name: Mime
jokers.description: Triggers the ability of every card held in hand a second time.

jokers.name: Credit Card
jokers.description: Lets you go up to -$20 in debt. Has no effect on scoring.

jokers.name: Banner
jokers.description: Gives +30 Chips for each discard you still have remaining.

jokers.name: Mystic Summit
jokers.description: Gives +15 Mult when you have 0 discards remaining.

jokers.name: Misprint
jokers.description: Gives a random amount of Mult between +0 and +23.
jokers.reason: Random per trigger. There is no exact value to compute.

jokers.name: Raised Fist
jokers.description: Adds double the rank of the lowest-ranked card held in your hand to Mult.

jokers.name: Fibonacci
jokers.description: Each played Ace, 2, 3, 5, or 8 gives +8 Mult when scored.

jokers.name: Steel Joker
jokers.description: Multiplies Mult by an extra 0.2 for each Steel Card in your full deck.

jokers.name: Scary Face
jokers.description: Each played face card (Jack, Queen or King) gives +30 Chips when scored.

jokers.name: Abstract Joker
jokers.description: Gives +3 Mult for each Joker card you are holding.

jokers.name: Gros Michel
jokers.description: Gives +15 Mult. At the end of each round there is a 1 in 6 chance this card is destroyed.

jokers.name: Even Steven
jokers.description: Each played card with an even rank (10, 8, 6, 4, 2) gives +4 Mult when scored.

jokers.name: Odd Todd
jokers.description: Each played card with an odd rank (Ace, 9, 7, 5, 3) gives +31 Chips when scored.

jokers.name: Scholar
jokers.description: Each played Ace gives +20 Chips and +4 Mult when scored.

jokers.name: Supernova
jokers.description: Adds the number of times you have played this poker hand this run to Mult.

jokers.name: Ride the Bus
jokers.description: Gains +1 Mult for every consecutive hand played that contains no face card. Resets when a face card is scored.

jokers.name: Green Joker
jokers.description: Gains +1 Mult per hand played, and loses 1 Mult per discard.

jokers.name: Photograph
jokers.description: The first face card (Jack, Queen or King) you play doubles your Mult when it scores.

jokers.name: Baron
jokers.description: Each King you are holding in hand multiplies your Mult by 1.5.

jokers.name: Blue Joker
jokers.description: Gives +2 Chips for every card still remaining in your deck.

jokers.name: Bull
jokers.description: Gives +2 Chips for each dollar you have.

jokers.name: Smeared Joker
jokers.description: Hearts and Diamonds count as the same suit, and Spades and Clubs count as the same suit.

jokers.name: Pareidolia
jokers.description: Every card counts as a face card.

jokers.name: Splash
jokers.description: Every played card counts toward the score, not just the ones making up the poker hand.

jokers.name: Shortcut
jokers.description: Straights can be made with gaps of one rank (for example 10, 8, 6, 5, 3).

jokers.name: Blackboard
jokers.description: Multiplies your Mult by 3 if every card left in your hand is a Spade or a Club.

jokers.name: Hack
jokers.description: Triggers each played 2, 3, 4 or 5 a second time.

jokers.name: Sock and Buskin
jokers.description: Triggers each played face card a second time.

jokers.name: Hanging Chad
jokers.description: Triggers the first card of your scored hand two extra times.

jokers.name: Dusk
jokers.description: Triggers every played card a second time, but only on the final hand of the round.

jokers.name: The Duo
jokers.description: Multiplies your Mult by 2 if your played hand contains a Pair.

jokers.name: The Trio
jokers.description: Multiplies your Mult by 3 if your played hand contains a Three of a Kind.

jokers.name: The Family
jokers.description: Multiplies your Mult by 4 if your played hand contains a Four of a Kind.

jokers.name: The Order
jokers.description: Multiplies your Mult by 3 if your played hand contains a Straight.

jokers.name: The Tribe
jokers.description: Multiplies your Mult by 2 if your played hand contains a Flush.

jokers.name: Triboulet
jokers.description: Each played King or Queen multiplies your Mult by 2 when it scores.

jokers.name: Smiley Face
jokers.description: Each played face card gives +5 Mult when scored.

jokers.name: Walkie Talkie
jokers.description: Each played 10 or 4 gives +10 Chips and +4 Mult when scored.

jokers.name: Arrowhead
jokers.description: Each played Spade gives +50 Chips when scored.

jokers.name: Onyx Agate
jokers.description: Each played Club gives +7 Mult when scored.

jokers.name: Stuntman
jokers.description: Gives +250 Chips, but reduces your hand size by 2.

jokers.name: Cavendish
jokers.description: Multiplies your Mult by 3. At the end of each round there is a 1 in 1000 chance this card is destroyed.

jokers.name: Ice Cream
jokers.description: Gives +100 Chips, and loses 5 Chips after every hand you play.

jokers.name: Popcorn
jokers.description: Gives +20 Mult, and loses 4 Mult after every round.

jokers.name: Wee Joker
jokers.description: Gains +8 Chips every time a 2 is played and scores.

jokers.name: Castle
jokers.description: Gains +3 Chips for each discarded card of a particular suit. The suit changes every round.

jokers.name: Obelisk
jokers.description: Multiplies Mult by an extra 0.2 for every consecutive hand you play that is not your most-played poker hand. Resets when you play your most-played hand.

jokers.name: Hologram
jokers.description: Multiplies Mult by an extra 0.25 every time you add a playing card to your deck.

jokers.name: Vampire
jokers.description: Multiplies Mult by an extra 0.1 for each scored card with an enhancement, and removes that enhancement.

jokers.name: Lucky Cat
jokers.description: Multiplies Mult by an extra 0.25 every time a Lucky card successfully triggers.

jokers.name: Madness
jokers.description: When you select a Small or Big Blind, multiplies Mult by an extra 0.5 and destroys a random Joker.

jokers.name: Constellation
jokers.description: Multiplies Mult by an extra 0.1 every time you use a Planet card.

jokers.name: Campfire
jokers.description: Multiplies Mult by an extra 0.25 for each card you sell. Resets when a Boss Blind is defeated.

jokers.name: Throwback
jokers.description: Multiplies Mult by an extra 0.25 for each Blind you have skipped this run.

jokers.name: Glass Joker
jokers.description: Multiplies Mult by an extra 0.75 for every Glass Card that has been destroyed.

jokers.name: Ramen
jokers.description: Multiplies Mult by 2, but loses 0.01 of that multiplier for every card you discard.

jokers.name: Blueprint
jokers.description: Copies the ability of the Joker directly to its right.
jokers.reason: Copy semantics, and Blueprint/Brainstorm chain ordering, are listed as unverified in spec section 9. Modelling them from assumption is exactly what that section forbids.

jokers.name: Brainstorm
jokers.description: Copies the ability of the leftmost Joker.
jokers.reason: See j_blueprint. Chain ordering unverified (spec section 9).

jokers.name: Card Sharp
jokers.description: Multiplies your Mult by 3 if this poker hand has already been played this round.
jokers.reason: Needs per-round hand history, which the canonical state does not carry.

jokers.name: Ancient Joker
jokers.description: Each played card of a particular suit multiplies your Mult by 1.5. The suit changes every round.
jokers.reason: The active suit is per-round state the canonical schema does not carry.

jokers.name: Bloodstone
jokers.description: Each played Heart has a 1 in 2 chance to multiply your Mult by 1.5.

jokers.name: 8 Ball
jokers.description: Each played 8 has a 1 in 4 chance to create a Tarot card. No scoring effect.

jokers.name: Business Card
jokers.description: Each played face card has a 1 in 2 chance to give $2. No scoring effect.

jokers.name: Rough Gem
jokers.description: Each played Diamond gives $1 when scored. No scoring effect.

jokers.name: Delayed Gratification
jokers.description: Gives $2 per discard if you use no discards by the end of the round. No scoring effect.
